K1.text: Staff cookie is a salted but deterministic digest of the shared passcode; no server-side session rows, revocation only by rotating the passcode for everyone (SEC-03, open). No sign-in links.

K2.text: Single shared passcode, no second factor and no per-user roles (not in the backlog as a fix item).

K3.text: Sweep of all 7 'use server' files and 3 route handlers: kitchen pages, actions and routes are guarded only by the /kitchen middleware matcher; no action calls a guard itself (SEC-04, open). Customer actions (cart, checkout) and /api/updates are public by design.
K3.evidence: apps/web/middleware.ts:16-45,64; apps/web/app/kitchen/actions.ts; apps/web/app/kitchen/settings/actions.ts; apps/web/app/kitchen/menu/actions.ts; apps/web/app/kitchen/loyalty/actions.ts; apps/web/app/kitchen/events/route.ts:12; apps/web/app/kitchen/report/export/route.ts

K4.text: Single-restaurant, single-tenant product with no accounts; the only per-customer handle is the 192-bit status token, which is the key itself (not-found on a wrong token).

K5.text: No rate limiter anywhere (grep for ratelimit/throttle hits only the kitchen prep-throttle); the passcode login, SMS verification start and public checkout are unthrottled (SEC-02, open).

K6.text: Status token is 192-bit random but stored raw (unique column), no expiry or revocation, page and next.config set no Referrer-Policy, no-store or noindex (SEC-05, open).

K7.text: next.config.ts defines no headers() and there is no headers block in vercel.json; no Referrer-Policy, nosniff, frame-ancestors or HSTS (no SEC item covers global headers).

K8.text: Passcode compare is constant-time over fixed-length digests, unset passcode locks /kitchen (fails closed), pepper unset refuses enrolment, no NEXT_PUBLIC vars found in the app or env example.

K9.text: Payment is a mock provider and there is no inbound webhook route among the 3 route handlers.

K10.text: SMS verification stub returns the code and requestCheckoutVerification hands echoedCode to the browser, including in production, and nothing fails loudly (SEC-01, open).

K11.text: No schema validation of env at boot (vars read ad hoc via process.env); .env.example does list DATABASE_URL, DIRECT_URL, PORT, STAFF_PASSCODE(_PREVIOUS) and LOYALTY_PHONE_PEPPER, names only, but that is only half the rule.

K12.text: Tests use local Postgres via .env.test with dotenv first-wins, assertLocalDatabase guards destructive scripts, e2e runs build:test then start:test (production build) with E2E_DEV escape hatch.

K13.text: OrderEvent (and adjustment/ledger tables) are append-only via DB triggers in migrations, including menu_change and staff_note events; spot-checked schema comments, not every migration.

K14.text: Port 3400 is the config default in package.json and playwright, but vercel.json still has no ignoreCommand (OPS-01, open); there are no cron routes. No commits landed since the baseline audit.
